name: L10 SEVN portal-private PP-OCRv6 medium witness fresh PAN Development
question: Can a typed portal-to-private-medium-observation-to-exact-token edge convert V2 abstentions into at least three additional correct door proposals on forty further fresh SEVN PAN episodes with no added wrong door?

cohort.disjointness: No address or panorama frame may overlap any of the six earlier SEVN panels; no frame may be reused across new episodes.

runtime.primary_ocr_backend: Frozen PP-OCRv6 small through RapidOCR and ONNX Runtime
runtime.portal_private_ocr_backend: Official PP-OCRv6 medium detector plus recognizer through PaddleOCR ONNX Runtime CPU
runtime.archive_integrity: Reuse the hash-bound full-archive MD5 receipt, verify current byte size, and record ZIP-member CRC plus SHA-256 for every selected panorama.

portal_medium_observation.trigger: Run only when V2 emits no selected binding and its state is UNKNOWN_TARGET_TEXT or UNKNOWN_NO_ADMISSIBLE_MASK_TOPOLOGY.
portal_medium_observation.portal_order: Descending frozen portal confidence, then stable candidate ID.
portal_medium_observation.credential_region: For each portal independently, reuse the V2 adaptive upper-mask neighborhood as that portal's private observation.
portal_medium_observation.pipeline: PaddleOCR 3.7.0 with the two hash-bound medium ONNX models, CPU device, document orientation disabled, document unwarping disabled, and text-line orientation disabled. Model configuration hashes freeze detection and recognition parameters.
portal_medium_observation.identity_rule: Within each portal-private crop, require score at least 0.5 and exact alphanumeric equality after deleting punctuation and spaces. No fuzzy, substring, edit-distance, character repair, or target-conditioned recognition is allowed.
portal_medium_observation.authority_edge: A portal owns a lexical witness only when its own private observation emits the requested exact token.
portal_medium_observation.unique_admission: Exactly one witnessing portal emits that portal. Zero witnesses remains UNKNOWN; more than one remains an explicit set and UNKNOWN.
portal_medium_observation.asymmetry: Never run after a V2 proposal and never replace, rerank, or revoke a V2 proposal.

representation_boundary: The new information is a typed portal-instance to private-medium-observation to exact-token provenance edge. It replaces global text-to-nearest-portal inference only on V2 abstentions; it does not widen spatial radii or reinterpret a global token as portal ownership. Renderer, prescribed PAN action, primary OCR, portal weights and masks, evaluator projection, and correctness stay fixed. Evaluator labels enter only after both outputs are sealed in memory.
execution_rule: Freeze source, evaluator and base-runner hashes, runtime, model revisions and hashes, portal crop and uniqueness semantics, metrics, and gates before opening any selected panorama member. Run one output-bearing invocation. Do not tune models, crops, trigger, uniqueness, gates, cohort, or runtime after observing results.
non_claims: The panel is same-source SEVN and PAN-only; it does not confirm a new city, provider, or APPROACH behavior.
A portal-private exact-token edge is Development binding evidence, not proof of portal ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, or safety.
Mask correctness uses evaluator door annotations after inference and does not enter private observation, OCR, witness generation, or selection.
The consumed V4 retrospective probe motivated this fresh experiment but has no confirmation authority and is not included in the V5 gate.
A failed gate closes only this frozen portal-witness mechanism on this cohort; UNKNOWN remains unknown rather than negative evidence.
